status: Public source prerelease and website live; v0.1.13-alpha.1 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB and Wi-Fi; native Grok Bot calls used daily on the owner's setup for one day
components.checks: The v0.1.13-alpha.1 hub release candidate records gateway 0.1.0a12 on PyPI (owner-approved trusted publishing on 13 October 2026; files byte-identical to the GitHub release's SHA256SUMS) with ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.13 (documentation only), Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.6 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. Adds ADR 008 and the daily-route record: on 13 October 2026 the owner's Grok Bot called the tools from the Mac and from the iPhone on cellular through a fixed-hostname tunnel with OAuth sign-in, and the route came back after a gateway restart, Mac sleep and a Mac restart. One day and one owner setup; a second day, a calibrated usage rate and independent reproduction are not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; Wi-Fi device listener used by one physical kit; native Grok Bot calls through serve --oauth used daily on the owner's setup
components.checks: 246 tests (Python 3.11 to 3.14), Ruff, plain-language checks and the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed; PyPI 0.1.0a12 matches the release's SHA256SUMS. Adds sign-in flood limits, request and service log rotation, route status in service status, service install --usage-hook and a local macOS notification hook example. On 13 October 2026 the owner ran this release as the always-on service behind a fixed-hostname tunnel (hub docs/verification/daily-route-2026-10-13.md). Linux systemd is not tested on a real host.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10; Ruff, package builds and twine check passed. The gateway extra pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10, so the SDK and its gateway install from PyPI. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (9/9), the contract check, the gateway PTY integration and three firmware builds passed. Alpha.12 resolves a .local gateway name with ESPmDNS and verifies TLS by name; on the owner's kit it connected by name and followed two Mac address changes and a restart. Earlier USB, Wi-Fi, wrong-password and face checks stand. One kit; not independently reproduced. v0.2.0-alpha.13 is documentation only: the library, firmware and examples are unchanged from v0.2.0-alpha.12, and the release reuses its library archive and SHA256SUMS.

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.

firmware.status: build verified; hardware and Grok pending; unpublished
